title: Where the File Stops
scopeNote: This keeps the two rounds of evidence, the commitment after each and both commitments kept, and adds the remedies table in which each explanation names an intervention and what it leaves running. A third round, the tracking across three, and the report-writing exercise are in the longer version.
summary: Four measurements of individuals support an explanation in terms of individuals. Then the rota, the queue, the target and a comparison team arrive, and nothing from the first round has been withdrawn.
learningObjectives: Explain why a real difference between people does not locate the cause inside them.
Recognise that the level a file measures decides the level its conclusion can reach.
Distinguish describing a pattern from naming a cause.
Say what each level of explanation would change and who would have to act.
Say what each remedy would leave running.
interactionTypes: two rounds of evidence with a commitment after each
both commitments kept and displayed together
feedback that treats the individual reading as well supported in round one
answer order rotated between the rounds
a remedies table whose final column is never empty
privacy: Nothing is collected, stored or transmitted. Nothing is asked about the reader.
dataStatus: A fictional team in a fictional public service. Every figure was written for teaching, and the correlation, the exhaustion means and the sign-off time are illustrative rather than estimates of anything.
accessibilityNotes: Keyboard operable throughout. Both rounds of evidence are ordinary lists, and each commitment is a choice grid whose options carry three non-colour state signals plus a visually hidden sentence naming the state; once answered they are locked with aria-disabled rather than the disabled attribute so they stay reachable and readable. Both commitments are shown as readout tiles from the moment each is made. The remedies are a real table with row and column headers and every cell is a sentence. Nothing is timed and there is no motion.
simulationNotes: The design of round one is the whole point and it is not a trap about the learner's reasoning. Every item in round one is a measurement of individuals, so an individual-level explanation is the best-supported reading of it, and the feedback says so rather than marking it wrong; declining to choose is treated as equally good, because refusing to rank levels from a single-level file is an accurate report of what it supports. The two other answers are marked partial and described as ahead of the evidence in a useful direction. The test suite verifies the design directly: round one mentions no rota, queue, target or sign-off and contains no observation of supervision or escalation, and no item in it compares the team with anything. Round two adds the relational and structural items and the comparison team, and the page states in three places that the comparison is the strongest-looking item and also the weakest, because the two teams were matched at recruitment and are not matched now. Answer order is rotated between the rounds so that no answer sits in the same position twice, which the test suite checks. The remedies table is where the theory does something: each explanation names an intervention, who would have to act and what it would leave running, and no row's final column is empty. One defect found during construction: the first commitment was rendered only once the second arrived, leaving the panel blank through the whole of round two, which is exactly when a learner wants to see what they said before.
readmeTopic: why what somebody measured decides what the explanation can be about
